title: 一鲸五域：空间位置与远近关系
note: 侧视世界原画表达头端、内脏、脊椎与尾端的空间关系；并非按解剖比例绘制。房间编号、唯一连接和门槛见结构图，画中的亮线只代表路线方向，不能作为额外通道。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide landscape original 2D side-view cutaway world map painting for an underwater action adventure inside ONE enormous DEAD baleen whale lying on the seabed. No text. The whale head is on the LEFT and tail far RIGHT. Show upper-jaw hanging baleen at far left lower mouth, a separate silver concentric ear-bone chamber inside the LEFT skull above the mouth, transparent blue lung membranes and a muted crimson heart in anterior upper torso, ochre folded stomach and olive intestinal passages below the torso, chalk-white segmented spine and ribs along the back running toward the far RIGHT tail root, a small teal nursery release basin near the tail. The ear chamber and tail basin must be clearly far apart, linked through the spine rather than touching. Regions visibly distinct, no human masonry or towers. Fine red repair cords, naturally formed shell shelters, living marine symbionts, old migration traces. Readable side-view platforms, terraces, small shelters, a few broad door apertures and narrow optional alcoves integrated into organic cavities. Three levels of visual depth with dark foreground seabed silhouettes, clear playable ledges, low contrast distant membranes. Hand-inked contours and restrained gouache washes, poetic melancholy, dark navy water, ivory bone, oxidized teal, amber lights. Draw a large coherent whale silhouette with visible flukes, no gore, no living or resurrected whale. This is a spatial concept map, not a room-count diagram. No character closeup, no logo, no UI, no recognizable characters or locations from any existing game, no horned masks, no insect kingdom, no nail swords, no stag station. Architectural readability and connected cavities are more important than decorative spectacle.

title: 胃枢：首次分流与回访高路
note: R3-01 胃枢的美术方向：下部固定台可达肠侧主路，侧门指向肺心；高处沉积袋为 A2 回访口，强流闸为 P＋A3 门。准确门位以逐房布局为准，画面不合并其他房间。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original 2D SIDE-VIEW cutaway level painting of a SINGLE stomach hub room inside a dead underwater baleen whale, using reference 1 ONLY for organic materials and hand-painted style, and reference 2 ONLY for hero identity. Wide landscape. Clearly designed three-level gameplay architecture rather than scenery. At the lower left a shell camp on a wide safe fixed ledge. The main lower floor consists of broad folded-tissue steps, short ordinary-jump gaps and visible catch floor, leading to an intestinal exit on the lower right without requiring flotation. Upper left a separate lung-side aperture framed by translucent blue membranes. Upper centre an alluring small sediment-pouch doorway substantially above normal jumping height with a visible memory-chip glint, reserved for later flotation. Right middle a tall strong-current grille with two clearly separate physical sockets, a flow valve and a red-cord anchor ring, indicating combined progression requirements. One separate high return doorway on the far left with a closed far-side shell latch. Keep every exit visually separated and reachable on its intended route. Foreground dark sparse shell silhouettes never cover ledge tops; playable midground crisp contact edges; background huge soft ochre stomach folds and tiny old shell shelters; suspended olive particles and restrained amber rim lighting. All underwater, no dry fire. One small original scavenger protagonist at camp: ivory ROUND helmet, SINGLE dark circular lens, short petrol teal cape, charcoal limbs and webbed feet, one amber lamp at anatomical LEFT hip, U-shaped two-prong resonator and red tether. Hero scale around 6 percent of image height. Safe hub with no attacking enemies. Hand-drawn ink and gouache, melancholy, mysterious. No human stone architecture, no readable text, no HUD, no copied game map, no horned mask, no insect kingdom, no nail sword.

title: 断脊：上层迎珠与下层锚越
note: R4-02 至 R4-05 的压缩关系原画：左侧安全练习后选择上层迎珠路线或下层锚路线，右侧重新会合。原画省略房间切换，不能按画面连续跨屏跳；实际环距、落点与门位以房间图为准。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide original 2D SIDE-VIEW level cutaway concept painting inside the spine of a DEAD underwater whale. Reference 1 supplies bone materials and visual style ONLY; reference 2 supplies hero identity ONLY. Show an explicit two-route choice from a wide safe training platform at LEFT to a wide reunion platform at RIGHT. UPPER route: three ivory bone platforms of changing height, a clearly visible intact glowing calcium pearl fired by a small rooted clam, one modest gap for a single air dash after pearl parry, no vertical chain of bouncing enemies. LOWER route: a stable series of bone shelves with THREE fixed red-cord anchor rings, individually spaced, safe standing landings between them and one armored marine crab on a broad combat shelf. Bottom recovery layer is a continuous visible blue-green microbial mat with stairs back to the left, not an abyss. The two routes visibly converge on a single right-hand vestibule with a closed large bivalve-shaped boss doorway; do not draw a fight in the vestibule. At the upper left a small optional broken-cord nook with subtle light but no extra route into the boss. Far background giant low-contrast ribs, distant marine silhouettes; foreground dark sparse coral never obscures platforms or hazards. One small protagonist on left safety platform: ivory ROUND helmet, SINGLE circular dark lens, short petrol teal cape, charcoal webbed limbs, one amber lamp at anatomical LEFT hip, U-shaped two-prong tool, red tether. No duplicate ghost protagonist. Hand-inked clean contours, dry-brush gouache, navy teal water, warm ivory bone, coral red cord and restrained amber. No text, no arrows, no UI, no horns, no nail sword, no copied existing characters or locations, no human masonry. Strong gameplay readability and layered parallax-like depth.
